units.source_text: “老爷，我已经拿到三番（舅舅的村子）还给我们的钱了。

en.t: Sir, I have already received the money that Sanban, my uncle's village, returned to us.

units.source_text: 小畑那份也是用从津江（姑奶奶的村子）借来的钱还的，请您放心吧。”

en.t: Obata's share was also repaid with money borrowed from Tsue, my great-aunt's village, so please rest easy.
